text: Usage proof: ObservationRdmPrepared, SamplewiseRsaPrepared, and FeatureModelPrepared are constructed at bind time but never read by any task or consumer; each can be Unit after validation. FirstOrderPrepared.queryTranspose is genuinely consumed, while its query axis duplicates estimand.query.output and can be removed. Tree-wide type-name search finds each affected result/receipt only in its defining file and focused suite. Result measurement/definition and computation source/design/measurement identities are asserted only by tests; AnalysisResult.plan plus MeasurementValue.measurement are authoritative. RDM domain already owns sample/pair axes; RSA/feature samples and target axes and first-order query/local axes remain intrinsic output shape. Generic materialization/operator counts belong to MeasurementExecutionReceipt; only feature fold evidence and first-order partition/output details are method-specific work.
